_comment: Consolidation-managed docs (/potion:consolidate + the session-start staleness nag). Per entry: path (repo-relative) · role (one-line contract for what the file is FOR — the rewrite must land inside it) · open_list (optional: the ONE file open items belong in; entries here hold pointers only) · cap_lines (optional growth trigger) · stale_days (age trigger, default 30) · last_consolidated (YYYY-MM-DD, bumped by the skill). Humans pick roles and caps; the skill only bumps dates.

docs.role: closed tester log + root causes + standing product decisions
